name: gridguard-ai-root
description: GridGuard AI - Predictive Grid Resilience & Equipment Failure Advisor (IBM Bob Hackathon)

scripts.install:all: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.dev:backend: sh -c 'if [ -f src/backend/venv/bin/uvicorn ]; then src/backend/venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir src/backend --reload --port 8000; else python -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir src/backend --reload --port 8000; fi'
scripts.test:backend: sh -c 'if [ -f src/backend/venv/bin/pytest ]; then PYTHONPATH=src/backend src/backend/venv/bin/pytest src/backend/tests -v; else pytest src/backend/tests -v; fi'
